title: cicerbita neglecta
intro: Cicerbita neglecta, commonly known as Indian mullein, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help in soothing digestive issues and relieving respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Indian mullein include its ability to calm coughs, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
